verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a built-in assistant, Kai, that offers guidance, real-time answers and hands-on support during onboarding. Its Spend AI also performs work inside the product, such as matching receipts and filling bill accounting fields, with review and override controls. However, Kai is shown only as an onboarding help and Q&A assistant, not an agent users hand open-ended tasks to, and the Spend AI features are fixed automations rather than delegation to an assistant. Missing for 10: documented free-form task delegation to Kai, evidence of the assistant acting beyond onboarding, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Kai gives you tailored guidance, real-time answers, and hands-on support, so you can onboard with confidence.
Simply attach your bill, then watch AI fill out accounting fields before routing it for approval.
AI captures receipts and matches them to the right card transactions without manual input from employees.
You always stay in control, with clear visibility into AI-driven actions and the ability to review, adjust, or override them.
